data.title: Pohanská – the gateway of the Celtic oppidum
data.excerpt: An artistic impression of the gateway and part of the fortification of the Celtic oppidum of Pohanská. The gateway, with a double pincer-shaped fortification, stood in the north-eastern part of the hillfort; the drawing is the work of Haden Sutton.
data.metaTitle: Pohanská – the gateway of the Celtic oppidum
data.metaDescription: An artistic reconstruction of the gateway with a double pincer-shaped fortification at the Celtic oppidum of Pohanská, as drawn by Haden Sutton.

keyFacts.label: Position of the gateway
